swap_risks: CRITICAL PACKAGE MISMATCH: TPS61221DCKR uses SC-70-6 (6-pin, DCK) while TPS613221ADBVR uses SOT-23-5 (5-pin, DBV); PCB footprint redesign is mandatory.

CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (VIN vs SW), Pin 2 (FB vs GND), Pin 3 (GND vs NC), Pin 5 (SW vs NC), Pin 6 (EN vs NONE). Soldering TPS613221ADBVR onto a TPS61221DCKR footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.

HIGH SWITCHING FREQUENCY SHIFT: fsw differs by 49% (TPS61221DCKR: 812 kHz p.14 vs TPS613221ADBVR: 1600 kHz p.9); re-evaluate inductor core loss, ripple current ΔIL, output capacitor ESR ripple, and EMI harmonics.
CAUTION INDUCTOR RETUNING: Typical inductor differs (TPS61221DCKR: 4.7 µH p.13 vs TPS613221ADBVR: 2.2 µH p.4); check inductor Isat against peak switch current limit.

CAUTION CURRENT RATING BASIS: TPS61221DCKR specifies 400 mA (switch current limit Isw, p.4) vs TPS613221ADBVR 1200 mA (switch current limit Isw, p.5). Remember boost Iout,max is strictly less than Isw due to duty-cycle scaling.
engineering_verdict: TPS61221DCKR (Texas Instruments, SC-70-6) and TPS613221ADBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are NOT pin-to-pin drop-in compatible (Level 3 PCB Layout Change Required) due to package/footprint mismatch; pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (VIN vs SW), Pin 2 (FB vs GND), Pin 3 (GND vs NC), Pin 5 (SW vs NC), Pin 6 (EN vs NONE). Key datasheet deltas: topology is boost (sync) vs boost (sync), switching frequency is 812 kHz (p.14) vs 1600 kHz (p.9), rated current is 400 mA (p.4) vs 1200 mA (p.5), typical inductor is 4.7 µH (p.13) vs 2.2 µH (p.4), and Iq is 5.5 µA (p.4) vs 6.5 µA (p.5). Always validate pinout orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.3), thermal margin (θJA 231.2 vs 189.7 °C/W), and official manufacturer datasheets on hardware prototypes before production release.
